missing_methods.intent: Assert user profile name is visible in dashboard header
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the user profile name element in the dashboard header to be visible. Verify that the displayed profile name matches the expected_name parameter. Return True if visible and matches, otherwise raise an assertion error with a descriptive message.

missing_methods.intent: Assert user profile name is displayed
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Locate the user profile name element in the dashboard header. Assert that the element is displayed on the page and that its text content matches the expected_name parameter. This method should use explicit waits to ensure the element is present before performing the assertion.
